about: These labelled pairs were written independently by an LLM from systems-engineering knowledge and the project's label definitions, without reading any code in the engine repository. All sentences are invented and generic; the order of pairs and the a/b sides were shuffled with a fixed seed.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall weigh no more than 5 kg.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall weigh no more than 8 kg.
pairs.why: Weighing at most 5 kg implies at most 8 kg.

pairs.a: The pump shall be rated at 2 kW.
pairs.b: The heater shall be rated at 2 kW.
pairs.why: Different actors that happen to share a rating value.

pairs.a: The controller shall persist its configuration across power cycles.
pairs.b: The controller shall retain its cfg after power is removed and restored.
pairs.why: Persisting across power cycles is retaining after power removal and restoration.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall take at least 1 s to come to rest after an emergency stop.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall stop within 0.2 s of an emergency stop.
pairs.why: Stopping within 0.2 s excludes taking at least 1 s; the second is a paraphrase.

pairs.a: The pump discharge pressure shall be not more than 600 kPa.
pairs.b: The pump discharge pressure shall be no more than 6 bar.
pairs.why: 1 bar is 100 kPa so both state the same upper limit.

pairs.a: The lift shall provide emergency lighting during a power failure.
pairs.b: The lift shall prevent the car from being overloaded.
pairs.why: Same device, independent safety functions.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall stop within 2 s of a jam.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall display the temperature within 2 s of a change.
pairs.why: Different actors and functions that share only a time limit.

pairs.a: The lift shall hold the door open for four seconds at each stop.
pairs.b: At every stop the car door shall stay open for ten seconds.
pairs.why: Reworded sentences with different durations (4 s versus 10 s) and no comparator.

pairs.a: The analyser shall report concentration in mol/L only.
pairs.b: The analyser shall report concentration in mg/L only.
pairs.why: 'only' makes the two reporting units mutually exclusive.

pairs.a: The logger shall store data in volatile memory only.
pairs.b: The logger shall store data in non-volatile memory only.
pairs.why: Volatile and non-volatile storage are mutually exclusive, and 'only' excludes the other.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall comply with REQ-ARM-014.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall comply with REQ-ARM-041.
pairs.why: Same statement but a different referenced requirement id; a human must decide which is meant.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall switch to night mode at 22:00.
pairs.b: Night mode shall be entered by the thermostat at 23:00.
pairs.why: Passive paraphrase with a different time of day for the same action.

pairs.a: The sensor shall draw no more than 0.01 A.
pairs.b: The sensor shall draw no more than 2 mA.
pairs.why: 0.01 A is 10 mA, so at most 2 mA implies at most 10 mA.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall carry a payload of no less than 5000 g.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall carry a payload of at least 5 kg.
pairs.why: 'at least' equals 'no less than' and 5 kg equals 5000 g.

pairs.a: The battery pack mass shall be at least 12 kg.
pairs.b: The battery pack mass shall not exceed 10 kg.
pairs.why: A minimum of 12 kg and a maximum of 10 kg cannot both be met.

pairs.a: The sensor output shall not exceed 0.25 V.
pairs.b: The sensor output shall not exceed 250 mV.
pairs.why: 250 mV equals 0.25 V.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall run at 0.6 m/s.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall move at 0.6 m/s.
pairs.why: Different actors; the equal speed is coincidental.

pairs.a: The pump controller shall not start the pump when the tank is full.
pairs.b: The pump controller shall start the pump when the tank is full.
pairs.why: Opposite polarity for the same action under the same condition.

pairs.a: The battery state of charge of each connected drone shall be displayed by the ground station.
pairs.b: The ground station shall display the battery state of charge of each connected drone.
pairs.why: Active versus passive voice; same actor, action and object.

pairs.a: Stored logs shall not be deleted.
pairs.b: Stored logs shall be deleted after 30 days.
pairs.why: Deleting after 30 days contradicts never deleting.

pairs.a: The pump shall run for no more than two hours continuously.
pairs.b: The pump shall run for no more than 120 min continuously.
pairs.why: two hours equals 120 min.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall hold the room temperature within ±1 degree C of the setpoint.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall hold the room temperature within ±0.5 degrees C of the setpoint.
pairs.why: A tolerance band of ±0.5 degrees C implies the wider ±1 degree C band (tolerances are bounds here, a convention chosen for this file).

pairs.a: The conveyor shall run at no more than 1.0 m/s.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall run at no less than 0.2 m/s.
pairs.why: Lower and upper bound of one speed range.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall have a hysteresis of 0.5 degrees C.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall have a hysteresis of 1 degree C.
pairs.why: Unqualified hysteresis values differ.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall have a setpoint range of 5 to 30 degrees C.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall be mounted at a height of 1.5 m.
pairs.why: Same actor, unrelated properties (setpoint range versus mounting height).

pairs.a: The charger shall hold the float voltage for 4 h.
pairs.b: The charger shall hold the float voltage for 4 min.
pairs.why: Same number with a different unit (h versus min).

pairs.a: The inverter output voltage shall be 230 V +/- 5 %.
pairs.b: The inverter output voltage shall be 230 V ± 5 %.
pairs.why: '+/-' and '±' are two spellings of the same tolerance symbol.

pairs.a: The valve shall close 5 s after the stop command.
pairs.b: The valve shall close 3 s after the stop command.
pairs.why: Same delay slot with a different value and no comparator.

pairs.a: The logger shall retain data for no less than thirty days.
pairs.b: The logger shall retain data for at least 30 days.
pairs.why: 'at least' equals 'no less than' and thirty equals 30.

pairs.a: The ground station shall declare link loss after 0.5 min without telemetry.
pairs.b: The ground station shall declare link loss after 30 s without telemetry.
pairs.why: 0.5 min equals 30 s.

pairs.a: A result shall only be discarded by the analyser after the operator confirms.
pairs.b: The analyser shall require operator confirmation before discarding a result.
pairs.why: Both make operator confirmation a precondition of discarding a result.

pairs.a: The logger shall retain data for at least 90 days.
pairs.b: The logger shall retain data for at least 30 days.
pairs.why: At least 90 days implies at least 30 days.

pairs.a: On loss of power, the robot arm shall keep its pose.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall hold its position when power is lost.
pairs.why: hold position equals keep pose and 'when power is lost' equals 'on loss of power'.

pairs.a: The ground station shall display the drone battery voltage.
pairs.b: The ground station shall display the drone altitude.
pairs.why: Same actor and action but a different object (altitude versus battery voltage).

pairs.a: The logger shall not overwrite any records when memory is full.
pairs.b: The logger shall overwrite the oldest records when memory is full.
pairs.why: One requires overwriting and the other forbids it in the same condition.

pairs.a: The sensor current shall be no more than 20 mA.
pairs.b: The sensor current shall be at least 4 mA.
pairs.why: Lower and upper bound of one current range.

pairs.a: The valve shall close in exactly 10 s.
pairs.b: The valve shall close in exactly 5 s.
pairs.why: Two different exact values for one quantity cannot both hold.

pairs.a: When the tank level falls below 20 %, the pump controller shall start the fill pump.
pairs.b: When the tank level reaches 90 %, the pump controller shall stop the fill pump.
pairs.why: Start and stop thresholds together specify one fill-control cycle.

pairs.a: The lift shall wait 5 s before closing the door.
pairs.b: The lift shall wait 8 s before closing the door.
pairs.why: Door-close delay value differs.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall provide a nominal voltage of 48 V.
pairs.b: The battery pack shall provide a nominal voltage of 24 V.
pairs.why: Nominal voltage value differs; a nominal value is not an exclusive state.

pairs.a: The controller shall reject unauthenticated commands.
pairs.b: The controller shall reject every command that is malformed, out of range or unauthenticated.
pairs.why: B is one of the three cases A requires to be rejected.

pairs.a: The analyser shall present results as a PDF report.
pairs.b: The analyser shall calibrate itself at start-up.
pairs.why: Same device, independent functions (calibration versus reporting).

pairs.a: The data logger shall sample the input at 20 Hz.
pairs.b: The data logger shall sample the input at 10 Hz.
pairs.why: Same actor, action and object; the unqualified sampling rate differs, so a human must choose.

pairs.a: The charger shall hold the float voltage for at least 4 h.
pairs.b: The charger shall hold the float voltage for at least 1 h.
pairs.why: At least 4 h implies at least 1 h.

pairs.a: The lift shall travel only when all doors are closed.
pairs.b: The lift shall not travel unless all doors are closed.
pairs.why: 'not ... unless' and 'only when' express the same necessary condition.

pairs.a: The thermostat setpoint shall be no lower than 5 degrees C.
pairs.b: The thermostat setpoint shall be no higher than 30 degrees C.
pairs.why: Lower and upper limits of one setpoint range.

pairs.a: The unit shall be powered from a 12 V supply only.
pairs.b: The unit shall be powered from a 24 V supply only.
pairs.why: 'only' makes the two supply voltages mutually exclusive.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall open the main contactor if the pack voltage drops under 40 V.
pairs.b: When the pack voltage falls below 40 V, the battery pack shall open its main contactor.
pairs.why: falls below equals drops under and when equals if here; same threshold and action.

pairs.a: The data logger shall encrypt data in transit.
pairs.b: The data logger shall encrypt data at rest and in transit.
pairs.why: B adds encryption at rest to what A requires.

pairs.a: The data logger shall sample at no less than 10 Hz.
pairs.b: The data logger shall sample at no more than 100 Hz.
pairs.why: Lower and upper bound of one sampling-rate range; neither implies the other.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall remain stopped until the operator resets the emergency stop.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall stop within 0.5 s of an emergency stop.
pairs.why: Reaction time and latching behaviour jointly describe the emergency-stop response.

pairs.a: The ground station shall retain mission logs for 90 days.
pairs.b: The ground station shall retain mission logs for 30 days.
pairs.why: Unqualified retention periods differ; no comparator is given, so a human decides.

pairs.a: The analyser shall finish a run within 52 s.
pairs.b: The analyser shall finish a run within 25 s.
pairs.why: Within 25 s implies within 52 s; the transposed digits make the bounds differ.

pairs.a: The logger shall not overwrite records that have not been uploaded.
pairs.b: the logger SHALL NOT overwrite records that have not been uploaded
pairs.why: Only letter case and the final full stop differ.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall run at 0.8 m/s.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall run at 0.5 m/s.
pairs.why: Unqualified belt speeds differ; no 'exactly' or 'only', so this is a value variant for a human to resolve.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall switch the heating on when the temperature is 1 degree C below the setpoint.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall switch the heating off when the temperature is 1 degree C above the setpoint.
pairs.why: On and off thresholds together define the hysteresis band.

pairs.a: The command link shall use a 128-bit key.
pairs.b: The command link shall use a 256-bit key.
pairs.why: Key length differs and neither is qualified as a minimum or maximum.

pairs.a: The analyser shall run a calibration after every 50 measurements.
pairs.b: The analyser shall run a calibration at start-up.
pairs.why: Same action and object; the triggering condition differs and the two can coexist.

pairs.a: The memory buffer shall hold 1000 records.
pairs.b: The memory buffer shall hold 10000 records.
pairs.why: Capacity differs by one digit (a changed number of zeros).

pairs.a: The battery pack shall draw no more than 5 A.
pairs.b: The battery pack shall weigh no more than 5 kg.
pairs.why: Same actor and number but different quantities (mass versus current).

pairs.a: The conveyor shall stop whenever any guard is opened.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall stop when the maintenance hatch guard is opened.
pairs.why: The hatch guard is one of the guards, so A implies B.

pairs.a: The lift shall not move when the door is open.
pairs.b: The lift shall not move when the door is open or the load exceeds 1000 kg.
pairs.why: A forbids movement in a superset of the situations B forbids.

pairs.a: The data logger shall be available at least 99.9 % of the time.
pairs.b: The data logger shall be available at least 99 % of the time.
pairs.why: For a minimum the larger number is stricter: 99.9 % implies 99 %.

pairs.a: When the link is lost, the ground station shall raise an alarm.
pairs.b: When the link is lost, the ground station shall log the event.
pairs.why: Two different actions that together specify the response to link loss; neither implies the other.

pairs.a: The relay shall release in exactly 5 s.
pairs.b: The relay shall release in exactly 5 ms.
pairs.why: Same number but different unit with 'exactly': 5 s and 5 ms cannot both be exact.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall be charged at no less than 15 A.
pairs.b: The battery pack shall be charged at no more than 10 A.
pairs.why: A current cannot be both at most 10 A and at least 15 A.

pairs.a: Every operator action shall be recorded in the audit log.
pairs.b: Operator login attempts shall be recorded in the audit log.
pairs.why: A login attempt is an operator action, so recording every action implies recording login attempts.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall move at no less than 500 mm/s in manual mode.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall move at no more than 250 mm/s in manual mode.
pairs.why: No speed is both at most 250 mm/s and at least 500 mm/s.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall report the temperature every 5 min.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall report the temperature every 5 s.
pairs.why: Same number but the unit differs (s versus min), so the reporting period differs by a factor of 60.

pairs.a: The charger shall not start charging below 0 degrees C.
pairs.b: The charger shall not start charging above 45 degrees C.
pairs.why: Two limits that together define one permitted temperature window; neither implies the other.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall run at exactly 0.5 m/s.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall run at exactly 0.8 m/s.
pairs.why: Two incompatible exact speeds.

pairs.a: The pump controller shall log every start event.
pairs.b: The pump controller should log every start event.
pairs.why: Only the modal differs (shall versus should), so the obligation level needs a human decision.

pairs.a: Unauthorised users shall have no access to the configuration menu.
pairs.b: All users shall have access to the configuration menu.
pairs.why: All users includes unauthorised ones, so the two cannot both hold.

pairs.a: The battery pack output voltage shall be at least 36 V.
pairs.b: The battery pack output voltage shall be at most 54 V.
pairs.why: Lower and upper bound of one voltage window.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall run at 0.5 m/s.
pairs.b: The conveyor belt speed shall be 2000 m/h.
pairs.why: 2000 m/h is about 0.56 m/s, not 0.5 m/s; wording and unit are paraphrased and the value differs.

pairs.a: The logger shall encrypt stored data as required by REQ-SEC-007.
pairs.b: The logger shall encrypt stored data as required by REQ-SEC-017.
pairs.why: Only the referenced requirement id differs.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall maintain the room temperature within 0.5 degrees C above or below the setpoint.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall hold the room temperature within ±0.5 degrees C of the setpoint.
pairs.why: '0.5 above or below' is the ± 0.5 tolerance; maintain equals hold.

pairs.a: The logger may compress archived files.
pairs.b: The logger shall compress archived files.
pairs.why: Only the modal differs (shall versus may).

pairs.a: The pump controller shall stop the pump within 5 s of a dry-run detection.
pairs.b: The pump controller shall stop the pump within 2 s of a dry-run detection.
pairs.why: Stopping within 2 s implies stopping within 5 s, not the reverse.

pairs.a: The robot arm shall stop within 0.5 s.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall be painted grey.
pairs.why: Same actor but entirely different functions.

pairs.a: The pump shall deliver a pressure of at least 300 kPa.
pairs.b: The pump shall deliver a pressure of at least 4 bar.
pairs.why: 4 bar is 400 kPa, which is stricter than a minimum of 300 kPa.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall operate in heating mode only.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall operate in cooling mode only.
pairs.why: 'only' makes the two modes mutually exclusive.

pairs.a: When the lid is open, the analyser shall pause the measurement.
pairs.b: When the lid is unlocked, the analyser shall pause the measurement.
pairs.why: Same actor and action; the triggering condition differs (open versus unlocked).

pairs.a: The valve shall open in less than 500 ms.
pairs.b: The valve shall open in under 0.5 s.
pairs.why: 'less than' equals 'under' and 500 ms equals 0.5 s.

pairs.a: The lift shall bring the car to the nearest floor on any fault.
pairs.b: The lift shall bring the car to the nearest floor on a door fault.
pairs.why: A door fault is one kind of fault, so the 'any fault' requirement implies the door-fault one.

pairs.a: The system shall log all faults.
pairs.b: The system shall be painted grey.
pairs.why: Same generic template but entirely different functions.

pairs.a: The heater element shall be rated at 2 W.
pairs.b: The heater element shall be rated at 2 kW.
pairs.why: Same number with a different unit (kW versus W), a factor of 1000 apart.

pairs.a: The pump controller shall inhibit pump start-up while the suction pressure is below 0.2 bar.
pairs.b: The pump controller shall not start the pump when the suction pressure is under 0.2 bar.
pairs.why: Inhibiting start-up is not starting; below equals under; same threshold.

pairs.a: The unit shall respond to a query within 0.1 s.
pairs.b: The unit shall answer a query in 100 ms or less.
pairs.why: answer equals respond, '100 ms or less' equals 'within 0.1 s'.

pairs.a: The lift shall stop within 4 s of the stop command.
pairs.b: The lift shall stop within 3000 ms of the stop command.
pairs.why: 3000 ms is 3 s, which is stricter than 4 s.

pairs.a: Within 0.5 s of E-stop activation, the manipulator shall come to rest.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall stop within 0.5 s of an emergency stop being pressed.
pairs.why: E-stop activation is the emergency stop being pressed, a manipulator is the robot arm and coming to rest is stopping; same time limit.

pairs.a: The unit shall transmit while in silent mode.
pairs.b: The unit must not transmit while in silent mode.
pairs.why: Must not and shall are opposite polarity for the same action and condition.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall not exceed 60 degrees C.
pairs.b: The pump shall not exceed 60 degrees C.
pairs.why: Different actors; each limit applies to its own part.

pairs.a: The ground station shall archive mission logs for audit.
pairs.b: The ground station shall show the drone position on a map.
pairs.why: Same actor, two independent functions (live display versus archiving).

pairs.a: The lift door shall close automatically after remaining open for 5 s.
pairs.b: The lift door shall open when the car arrives at a floor.
pairs.why: Opening and closing together specify one door cycle.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall halt when a jam is detected.
pairs.b: On detection of a jam, the conveyor shall stop.
pairs.why: halt equals stop and 'on detection of' equals 'when detected'.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall operate between -20 and 60 degrees C.
pairs.b: The battery pack shall operate between -40 and 85 degrees C.
pairs.why: Operating over the wider range implies operating over the narrower range inside it.

pairs.a: The heater shall be disabled when the temperature is below 5 degrees C.
pairs.b: The heater shall be enabled when the temperature is below 5 degrees C.
pairs.why: Enabled and disabled are opposite states under the same condition.

pairs.a: When the tank level falls below 20 %, the pump controller shall start the fill pump.
pairs.b: The pump controller shall start the fill pump when the tank level falls below 20 %.
pairs.why: Same condition, actor and action; only the clause order differs.

pairs.a: The pump discharge pressure shall be at least 2 bar.
pairs.b: The pump discharge pressure shall be at most 6 bar.
pairs.why: Lower and upper bound of one pressure range.

pairs.a: All records written by the data logger shall carry a UTC time stamp.
pairs.b: The data logger shall timestamp every record using UTC.
pairs.why: Passive paraphrase: every record gets a UTC time stamp in both.

pairs.a: The analyser shall complete a measurement cycle in no more than 1.5 min.
pairs.b: The analyser shall complete a measurement cycle in no more than 90 s.
pairs.why: 1.5 min equals 90 s with the same comparator.

pairs.a: The lift door shall stay open for at least 10 s.
pairs.b: The lift door shall stay open for at most 5 s.
pairs.why: No duration is both at least 10 s and at most 5 s.

pairs.a: The analyser shall store results for 30 days.
pairs.b: The lift shall announce floors in two languages.
pairs.why: Different devices and functions.

pairs.a: The lift shall announce each floor.
pairs.b: The lift shall carry up to 1000 kg.
pairs.why: Same actor, unrelated functions (load capacity versus announcements).

pairs.a: The conveyor shall be stopped by the controller if no part is seen for 30 s.
pairs.b: If the sensor sees no part for 60 s, the controller shall stop the conveyor.
pairs.why: Paraphrased, but the no-part timeout differs (30 s versus 60 s).

pairs.a: The thermostat shall refresh its display once a minute.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall refresh its display every ten seconds.
pairs.why: Both are paraphrased periods (60 s versus 10 s); the value differs and a human must decide.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall never exceed 60 degrees C.
pairs.b: The battery pack shall not exceed 60 degrees C during charging.
pairs.why: Never exceeding at any time covers the charging case alone.

pairs.a: The battery pack shall not exceed 40 degrees C.
pairs.b: The battery pack shall not exceed 45 degrees C.
pairs.why: A ceiling of 40 degrees C implies a ceiling of 45 degrees C.

pairs.a: The ground station shall track at least 50 drones simultaneously.
pairs.b: The ground station shall track at least 20 drones simultaneously.
pairs.why: A minimum of 50 implies a minimum of 20.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall display the room temperature in degrees C.
pairs.b: The  thermostat shall display the room temperature in degrees C
pairs.why: Only extra whitespace and the missing final full stop differ.

pairs.a: When the lid is open and the rotor is spinning, the analyser shall sound an alarm.
pairs.b: The analyser shall sound an alarm when the rotor is spinning and the lid is open.
pairs.why: Same conjunction of conditions and same action, only reordered.

pairs.a: The data logger shall synchronise its clock with a time server.
pairs.b: The data logger shall compress archived files.
pairs.why: Same device, independent functions (storage versus timekeeping).

pairs.a: The unit should not transmit during self-test.
pairs.b: The unit shall not transmit during self-test.
pairs.why: Same prohibition but a different modal strength (shall not versus should not).

pairs.a: The conveyor shall stop within 1 s and sound the alarm.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall stop within 1 s.
pairs.why: A adds a conjunct (sound the alarm) on top of B, so A implies B.

pairs.a: The pump controller shall stop the pump within 2 s of a dry-run detection.
pairs.b: The pump controller shall stop the pump within 2000 ms of a dry-run detection.
pairs.why: 2 s equals 2000 ms and every other slot is identical.

pairs.a: The data logger shall sample at no less than 100 Hz.
pairs.b: The data logger shall sample at no more than 50 Hz.
pairs.why: No rate is both at least 100 Hz and at most 50 Hz.

pairs.a: The valve shall not close sooner than 5 s after the stop command.
pairs.b: The valve shall close within 2 s of the stop command.
pairs.why: Closing within 2 s excludes closing no sooner than 5 s.

pairs.a: The door shall remain open for at most 5 s.
pairs.b: The door shall remain open for at least 5 s.
pairs.why: A lower and an upper bound that together pin the duration to exactly 5 s; both can hold, neither implies the other.

pairs.a: The heater shall be switched off if the lid is open.
pairs.b: The heater shall not be switched off if the lid is open.
pairs.why: Opposite polarity under the same condition.

pairs.a: The ground station shall never send a command without operator confirmation.
pairs.b: The ground station shall not send a shutdown command without operator confirmation.
pairs.why: A shutdown command is one kind of command, so the general rule implies the specific one.

pairs.a: The battery pack temperature shall be at most 45 degrees C during charging.
pairs.b: The battery pack temperature shall be no more than 45 degrees C during charging.
pairs.why: 'at most' and 'no more than' state the same upper bound.

pairs.a: The conveyor must stop within 1 s of an emergency stop request.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall stop within 1 s of an emergency stop request.
pairs.why: Both 'must' and 'shall' mark a binding requirement; this file treats them as the same modal strength.

pairs.a: The logger shall sample at 10 Hz.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall sample at 10 Hz.
pairs.why: Different actors with the same value.

pairs.a: The setpoint shall be adjustable between 5 and 30 degrees C.
pairs.b: The setpoint shall be adjustable from 5 degrees C to 30 degrees C.
pairs.why: 'between 5 and 30' and 'from 5 to 30' describe the same inclusive range.

pairs.a: The thermostat shall offer a child lock on its keypad.
pairs.b: The thermostat shall minimise energy use when the room is unoccupied.
pairs.why: Same device, independent features.

pairs.a: When the pump temperature exceeds 80 degrees C, the controller shall shut down the pump.
pairs.b: When the pump temperature exceeds 90 degrees C, the controller shall shut down the pump.
pairs.why: Shutting down above 80 degrees C covers every case above 90 degrees C, so A implies B.

pairs.a: The pump shall feed the tank.
pairs.b: The tank shall feed the pump.
pairs.why: Swapped subject and object: different actors and functions; both can hold (for example in a recirculation loop) and neither implies the other.

pairs.a: The pump shall start when the level sensor reports high level.
pairs.b: The pump shall start when the level sensor reports low level.
pairs.why: Same actor and action; the triggering sensor state differs and both could hold.

pairs.a: All interfaces of the controller shall be galvanically isolated.
pairs.b: The CAN interface of the controller shall be galvanically isolated.
pairs.why: The CAN interface is one of the interfaces, so A implies B.

pairs.a: The tank heater shall draw no more than 1500 W.
pairs.b: The tank heater shall draw no more than 1.5 kW.
pairs.why: 1.5 kW equals 1500 W.

pairs.a: The valve shall close within 5 s.
pairs.b: The valve shall close within 5 ms.
pairs.why: Same number, different unit: within 5 ms implies within 5 s, not the reverse.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall not start if the guard door is open.
pairs.b: If the guard door is open, the conveyor shall not start.
pairs.why: Same prohibition under the same condition; only the clause order differs.

pairs.a: On reset the controller shall run a self-test.
pairs.b: On power-up the controller shall run a self-test.
pairs.why: Same actor, action and object; the triggering event differs.

pairs.a: The enclosure shall be rated IP65.
pairs.b: The cable gland shall be rated IP65.
pairs.why: Different parts with the same rating; neither statement constrains the other.

pairs.a: The lift shall carry a load of not more than 1000 kg.
pairs.b: The lift shall carry a load of up to 1000 kg.
pairs.why: 'up to' and 'not more than' state the same upper bound.

pairs.a: The analyser shall stop a running measurement when the lid is opened.
pairs.b: The analyser shall start a measurement only after the lid is closed.
pairs.why: Start interlock and stop interlock jointly specify the lid-safety behaviour.

pairs.a: The lift controller is required to log every door fault.
pairs.b: The lift controller is recommended to log every door fault.
pairs.why: The modal is expressed in words: required corresponds to shall and recommended to should.

pairs.a: The ground station shall record all telemetry.
pairs.b: The ground station shall not record any telemetry.
pairs.why: Recording all telemetry contradicts recording none.

pairs.a: The conveyor shall start automatically on power-up.
pairs.b: The conveyor shall not start automatically on power-up.
pairs.why: Dropped 'not': the two statements contradict each other.

pairs.a: On loss of power, the pump valve shall fail open.
pairs.b: On loss of power, the pump valve shall fail closed.
pairs.why: Open and closed are mutually exclusive states of the same valve in the same situation.

pairs.a: The data logger shall be powered by the battery pack.
pairs.b: The robot arm shall be controlled by the cell controller.
pairs.why: Different actors, actions and objects.

pairs.a: The sensor shall be sampled every 10 ms.
pairs.b: The sensor shall be sampled every 10 s.
pairs.why: Same number with a different unit (ms versus s).

pairs.a: The ground station shall refresh the telemetry display at 10 Hz.
pairs.b: The ground station shall refresh the telemetry display at 0.01 kHz.
pairs.why: 0.01 kHz equals 10 Hz.

pairs.a: The controller shall store its cfg in non-volatile memory.
pairs.b: The controller shall store its configuration in non-volatile memory.
pairs.why: cfg is a standard abbreviation of configuration.

pairs.a: The data logger shall send a status msg every five seconds.
pairs.b: The data logger shall send a status message every 5 s.
pairs.why: msg is an abbreviation of message and five seconds equals 5 s.

pairs.a: The pump shall start no later than 5 s after the valve opens.
pairs.b: The pump shall start no earlier than 2 s after the valve opens.
pairs.why: Earliest and latest start times jointly define one start window.

pairs.a: Alarms shall be cleared automatically without operator acknowledgement.
pairs.b: Alarms shall be acknowledged by the operator before they are cleared.
pairs.why: Requiring acknowledgement contradicts clearing without it.

pairs.a: The alarm shall sound when the tank level is above 10 %.
pairs.b: The alarm shall sound when the tank level is below 10 %.
pairs.why: The triggering condition differs in its comparator; both could hold together, so this is not a conflict.

pairs.a: The ground station should update the map at 5 Hz.
pairs.b: The ground station shall update the map at 5 Hz.
pairs.why: Only the modal differs (shall versus should).
